english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for challenging someone to compete or daring them to do something.

exampleSentences.english: I challenge you to race me.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 tiu1 zin3 nei5 tung4 ngo5 dau3 faai3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for challenging a person, authority, opponent, or danger.

exampleSentences.english: I dare to defy this obstacle.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gau3 daam2 tiu1 zin3 ni1 go3 naan4 gwaan1

english.note: Use this when contesting someone’s authority, position, decision, or claim in a confrontational sense.

exampleSentences.english: They openly contest the chairperson's decision.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢哋公開挑戰會長嘅決定。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gung1 hoi1 tiu1 zin3 wui6 zoeng2 ge3 kyut3 ding6
